items.name: Potion
items.description: Restores a small amount of health.

items.name: Mega Potion
items.description: Restores a moderate amount of health.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A cure for poison.

items.name: Max Potion
items.description: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health Gauge.

items.name: Ancient Potion
items.description: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health and Stamina Gauges.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

items.name: Ration
items.description: Food that restores a bit of stamina. It can also be used on the Portable BBQ Grill to have a meal.

items.name: Well-done Steak
items.description: A hearty roast that restores health and stamina and boosts both their max gauges. So tasty!

items.name: Rare Steak
items.description: Restores health and stamina and moderately increases the size of your Health Gauge temporarily.

items.name: Burnt Meat
items.description: Restores stamina, but it may be a bit too charred to provide any healing effects...

items.name: Lifepowder
items.description: Produces a cloud that heals you and anyone nearby.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Meat carved from a monster. Can be cooked, combined,  or used to set a trap.

items.name: Barrel Bomb
items.description: A small time bomb.

items.name: Large Barrel Bomb
items.description: A bomb that can be rolled after placing it on the ground. Strike it to trigger a powerful blast.

items.name: Flash Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that causes a violent flash on impact. Will temporarily blind monsters if used in front of them.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to hit faraway plant life and bombs.

items.name: Capture Net
items.description: A net that can be fired from your Slinger. Use it to capture small creatures.

items.name: Pitfall Trap
items.description: A trap for catching large monsters. It is tripped by heavy weight.

items.name: Shock Trap
items.description: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description: A standard-sized whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's sharpness.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: A tool that magnifies distant objects and lets you learn more about them.

items.name: Camping Kit
items.description: A kit with all the tools to make camp. Use to set up and edit Pop-up Camps in available campsites.

items.name: Portable BBQ Grill
items.description: A portable BBQ grill that can be used for grilling up raw meat and other ingredients.

items.name: Herb
items.description: A primary ingredient in potions.

items.name: Antidote Herb
items.description: A primary ingredient in antidotes.

items.name: Honey
items.description: Highly nutritious honey. Combine with potions to make the more potent mega potion.

items.name: Bitterbug Broth
items.description: Bitterbug essence that has innate healing abilities. Used as a component in many medicines.

items.name: Flashbug Phosphor
items.description: Luminous essence from an insect that emits a powerful flash when it dies. Used to craft flash pods.

items.name: Godbug Essence
items.description: Essence from an insect said to live a millennium. Combine it with other items to add their properties.

items.name: Thunderbug Capacitor
items.description: Substance from an insect that emits electricity when struck. Required to craft Shock Traps and Thunder Ammo.

items.name: Doshaguma Hide
items.description: A Doshaguma hide. The numerous scars on its body are proof of its beastly, aggressive nature.

items.name: Doshaguma Fur
items.description: Doshaguma fur. It makes a durable crafting material thanks to its stiff, bristly texture.

items.name: Doshaguma Claw
items.description: A Doshaguma claw. Sharp as it is tough, it can cut through muscled prey without a single chip.

items.name: Doshaguma Fang
items.description: A Doshaguma fang. They grow large and sharp so they can pierce their prey with ease.

items.name: Beast Gem
items.description: A valuable jewel formed from coagulated juices inside a monster. Glows wildly.

items.name: Normal Ammo
items.description: Standard ammo. Fires multiple shots with each pull of the trigger. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Pierce Ammo
items.description: Armor-piercing ammo. Depending on the monster, it can deal multiple hits. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Spread Ammo
items.description: Ammo made for close combat. Short range but high power. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Sticky Ammo
items.description: Powerful ammo that lodges in a target and explodes. Headshots stun.

items.name: Cluster Bomb
items.description: Ammo that fragments into multiple shells upon impact. Beware of friendly fire!

items.name: Flaming Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to fire.

items.name: Water Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to water.

items.name: Thunder Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to thunder.

items.name: Freeze Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to ice.

items.name: Dragon Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters weak to dragon.

items.name: Poison Ammo
items.description: Ammo that inflicts poison. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Paralysis Ammo
items.description: Ammo that causes paralysis. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Sleep Ammo
items.description: Ammo that induces sleep. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Slicing Ammo
items.description: Ammo that ejects sharp blades on impact, which can sever tails.

items.name: Thorngrass Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that lodges into a target. Attacking where it's lodged deals extra damage.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Ore that can be smelted into a multi-purpose metal.

items.name: Machalite Ore
items.description: Ore mined from mineral veins. Refined Machalite Steel is far sturdier than its iron cousin.

items.name: Dragonite Ore
items.description: Ore sourced from mining outcrops. A rare material coveted for its durability in armor crafting.

items.name: Carbalite Ore
items.description: Ore obtained from mining outcrops. Still under research, but known to yield highly pure metal.

items.name: Earth Crystal
items.description: Crystallized microbes sourced from mining outcrops. Coveted as an abrasive for polishing equipment.

items.name: Mystery Bone
items.description: A weathered bone taken from a bonepile. Erosion has left it too fragile to use in crafting.

items.name: Sturdy Bone
items.description: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

items.name: Brute Bone
items.description: A sturdy bone from a beast. Easy to use in crafting.

items.name: Colossal Bone
items.description: A massive bone from a beast. Carefully cut out and used for crafting.

items.name: Dragonbone Relic
items.description: A high-quality bone taken from a bonepile. The remains of a dragon that once roamed these lands.

items.name: Mandragora
items.description: A dangerous fungus said to draw the life out of people. Required to craft immunizers and max potions.

items.name: Blue Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom infused with power-enhancing effects. Used in restorative items.

items.name: Burst Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that detonates on impact. Use it to stagger a monster when you're in a pinch.

items.name: Screamer Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that emits a harsh, high-frequency sound that can disrupt sensitive monsters.

items.name: Bleeding Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to inflict massive damage on monster wounds.

items.name: Dung Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that releases a strong odor on impact. Causes certain monsters to flee.

items.name: Trap Tool
items.description: A must-have item for putting together pitfall traps and shock traps.

items.name: Exciteshroom
items.description: Has a very strange aroma. Is it edible? Is it deadly? Required to make farcasters.

items.name: Smokenut
items.description: A nut that produces torrents of smoke. Combine with other items to add more effects.

items.name: Ivy
items.description: A lightweight and extremely strong plant. Used to make nets for pitfall traps.

items.name: Farcaster
items.description: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Can also be used during combat.

items.name: Balahara Shell
items.description: A Balahara shell. The fulgurite it has absorbed enhances its hardness.

items.name: Balahara Scale
items.description: A Balahara scale. The erosion caused by constant digging limits its usefulness in crafting.

items.name: Balahara Skull
items.description: The skull of a Balahara. Stronger than most, it's built to withstand harsh dives into sand.

items.name: Balahara Tail
items.description: A Balahara tail. Its unique, twisted shape allows it to propel itself through earth with great force.

items.name: Chatacabra Jaw
items.description: The mandible plating of a Chatacabra. Hard protrusions stud the thick but supple leather.

items.name: Chatacabra Hide
items.description: The thick hide of a Chatacabra. Elastic and easy to mold thanks to the monster's gluttonous diet.

items.name: Chatacabra Shell
items.description: Plating that covers a Chatacabra's forelimbs. A lifetime of licking has left it both smooth and sturdy.

items.name: Chatacabra Scale
items.description: A jagged scale from a Chatacabra's hide, especially tough and well suited for use in crafting armor.

items.name: Quematrice Scale
items.description: The scale of a Quematrice. Its fine texture acts as a natural file used to grind and polish armor.

items.name: Quematrice Hide
items.description: The hide of a Quematrice. Quite thick despite its wrinkly form, it is highly resistant to fire.

items.name: Quematrice Crest
items.description: The crest of a Quematrice. Its flamboyant red color serves as a decoy to would-be predators.

items.name: Quematrice Tail
items.description: The tail of a Quematrice. Its many pleats scrape against each other to create sparks.

items.name: Wyvern Gem
items.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

items.name: Herbivore Shell
items.description: Part of a shell taken from an herbivore. Relatively sturdy for a small monster material.

items.name: Bulaqchi Shell
items.description: A Bulaqchi shell. Great for crafting thanks to its advanced durability and light weight.

items.name: Talioth Scale
items.description: A Talioth scale. Conditioned in harsh environments, it is built to protect the body like armor.

items.name: Sharp Fang
items.description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. Choose the right fang for the job.

items.name: Wingdrake Hide
items.description: A material carved from wingdrakes. Lightweight and often used when crafting armor.

items.name: Acute Fang
items.description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. This one is small but can still pierce scale.

items.name: Dung
items.description: Its eye-watering stench makes useful Slinger ammo.

items.name: Rolled-up Dung
items.description: A ball of condensed monster dung. Used to make dung pods for your Slinger.

items.name: Rathian Scale+
items.description: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale but is much harder.

items.name: Rathian Carapace
items.description: Rathian carapace prized for its lavish green coloration. An excellent armor material.

items.name: Rathian Webbing
items.description: A quality Rathian wing membrane. This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

items.name: Rathian Spike+
items.description: Rathian hairs, keen as a sword. Longer and sturdier than normal, they also contain more poison.

items.name: Rathian Ruby
items.description: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathian. Almost too nice to use.

items.name: Toadstool
items.description: A mushroom with poison properties. Needed to craft Poison Ammo and smoke bombs.

items.name: Parashroom
items.description: A mushroom that induces paralysis. Needed to craft Paralysis Ammo and tranq bombs.

items.name: Sleep Herb
items.description: A plant containing sleeping agents. Needed to craft Sleep Ammo and tranq bombs.

items.name: Fire Herb
items.description: A wondrous, flammable plant. Useful for crafting explosives and Flaming Ammo.

items.name: Flowfern
items.description: This plant's leaves store a great amount of water. A component for making Water Ammo.

items.name: Snow Herb
items.description: A plant that radiates ice-cold air. Use in combinations to create Freeze Ammo.

items.name: Dragonfell Berry
items.description: A mysterious berry rumored for eons to be loathed by dragons. Required to craft Dragon Ammo.

items.name: First-aid Med
items.description: Restores a small amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Ration
items.description: Restores a small amount of stamina. Not usable with Portable BBQ Grill. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Flash Bomb
items.description: Slinger ammo that explodes with a bright flash after it's fired. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Shock Trap
items.description: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Pitfall Trap
items.description: Activates a pitfall to catch monsters with. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Gloamgrass Bud
items.description: A plant with healing properties. Combine with Godbug essence to unleash its true potential.

items.name: Might Seed
items.description: Temporarily strengthens your attacks when ingested by improving energy flow.

items.name: Adamant Seed
items.description: Temporarily raises your defense when ingested by hardening tissue.

items.name: Nitroshroom
items.description: A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat. Required to craft gunpowder.

items.name: Devil's Blight
items.description: A very rare fungus that pulses with extreme heat. Add to a barrel bomb for a dramatically stronger blast.

items.name: Blastnut
items.description: A nut that explodes its hard contents on impact. Used to make Sticky Ammo.

items.name: Slashberry
items.description: A berry that shatters into razor-like pieces. Used to make Slicing Ammo.

items.name: Rey Dau Scale
items.description: A Rey Dau scale. Its unique shape allows electricity from its organs to pass through.

items.name: Rey Dau Shell
items.description: The shell from a Rey Dau. Highly conductive and capable of producing large electrical currents.

items.name: Rey Dau Thunderhorn
items.description: An electrically charged Rey Dau horn. The thick, flexible muscle at its base lets it move freely.

items.name: Rey Dau Wingtalon
items.description: The claw-shaped energy conduit of a Rey Dau. Coated in sharp fulgurite blades formed by electric discharges.

items.name: Rey Dau Tail
items.description: A Rey Dau tail. Its fulgurite-covered spines rub together to produce a threatening melody.

items.name: Rey Dau Plate
items.description: A Rey Dau plate. The backward-facing scale accumulates a massive amount of energy.

items.name: Tranq Blade
items.description: A knife coated with a tranquilizer that can be shot from your Slinger to put trapped monsters to sleep.

items.name: Poison Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting poison on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Paralysis Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting paralysis on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Sleep Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting sleep on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Creates a large cloud of smoke when thrown against the ground that can hide you from a monster's sight.

items.name: Powercharm
items.description: An amulet that strengthens attacks. Just carrying this gives you demonic strength.

items.name: Armorcharm
items.description: An amulet that increases defense. Just carrying this makes your skin stone hard.

items.name: Wyvern Ammo
items.description: Ammo created through years of research into Wyvern's Fire. Short ranged, but destructive.

items.name: Grounding Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can dissipate electricity from the area it lands.

items.name: Mystery Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with faint power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.name: Glowing Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with hidden power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.name: Ancient Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with incredible power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.name: Damaged Weapon Shard
items.description: An old, damaged weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Rusted Weapon Shard
items.description: An old, rusted weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Ghillie Mantle
items.description: Temporarily conceal yourself from view. The effect ends if you perform an attack or take damage.

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.description: A tool for fishing. Cast the lure into bodies of water and use the reel to wind in the line.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

items.name: Dash Juice
items.description: Recovers stamina and also temporarily reduces stamina depletion when performing actions.

items.name: Immunizer
items.description: Temporarily boosts your natural ability to recover lost health.

items.name: Cool Drink
items.description: Provides temporary relief from extreme heat.

items.name: Hot Drink
items.description: Provides temporary relief from extreme cold.

items.name: Demondrug
items.description: Temporarily boosts your attack power by filling you with demonic strength.

items.name: Might Pill
items.description: Temporarily endows you with the strength of a mighty god. Potent!

items.name: Mega Demondrug
items.description: Temporarily boosts your attack power even more than a regular Demondrug.

items.name: Armorskin
items.description: Temporarily boosts your defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

items.name: Adamant Pill
items.description: Temporarily makes your skin as hard as adamant. Potent!

items.name: Mega Armorskin
items.description: Temporarily boosts your defense even more than regular Armorskin.

items.name: Herbal Medicine
items.description: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of health.

items.name: Herbal Powder
items.description: Produces a cloud that cures poison and heals you a bit.

items.name: Demon Powder
items.description: A mysterious powder that produces a cloud around the area that temporarily strengthens attacks.

items.name: Hardshell Powder
items.description: A mysterious powder; when dispersed, temporarily strengthens defense.

items.name: Dust of Life
items.description: Produces a cloud that restores a large amount of health for you and anyone nearby.

items.name: Cleanser
items.description: Immediately removes any frost or webbing on your body.

items.name: Poison Smoke Bomb
items.description: Releases a cloud of toxic mist when used. Also popular as a household bug bomb.

items.name: Tranq Bomb
items.description: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Can be slammed against the ground.

items.name: Throwing Knife
items.description: A knife that can be equipped to your Slinger. Can be coated with a range of substances.

items.name: Poison Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that inflicts  poison on a target upon  impact.

items.name: Para Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that inflicts paralysis on a target upon impact.

items.name: Drugged Meat
items.description: Raw meat that puts whatever eats it to sleep. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: Brightmoss
items.description: Slinger ammo that illuminates dark areas when fired and can dazzle flying monsters.

items.name: Torch Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to scare away creatures that don't like fire and draw in those that do.

items.name: Puddle Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with water element. Can remove some statuses on monsters.

items.name: Bomb Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that explodes on impact.

items.name: Piercing Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that deals piercing damage on impact.

items.name: Paint Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that makes a monster or location temporarily easier to find.

items.name: Luring Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to lure monsters toward yourself.

items.name: Mega Barrel Bomb
items.description: An upgraded large barrel bomb. Effective against large monsters. Can be rolled after placement.

items.name: First-aid Med+
items.description: Restores a moderate amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Max Potion
items.description: Fully restores health and maximizes the size of your Health Gauge. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Lifepowder
items.description: Produces a cloud that heals you and anyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Herbal Powder
items.description: Cures poison and restores a bit of health for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Demon Powder
items.description: Temporarily strengthens attacks for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Hardshell Powder
items.description: Temporarily increases defense for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Dust of Life
items.description: Releases a cloud that restores a large amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Tranq Bomb
items.description: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Dung Pod
items.description: Releases a strong odor on impact. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Sonic Bomb
items.description: Slinger ammo that emits an earsplitting sonic blast. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Tinged Meat
items.description: Raw meat that paralyzes whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: EZ Large Barrel Bomb
items.description: An improved large barrel bomb. Can be rolled after being placed. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Farcaster
items.description: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Poisoned Meat
items.description: Raw meat that poisons whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: Deodorant
items.description: Produces a cloud of cleansing smoke that cures blastblight and stench.

items.name: Kunafa Cheese
items.description: An artisan cheese made in Kunafa, deliciously gooey when heated, and a great addition to any dish.

items.name: Sharp Kunafa Cheese
items.description: A rich, decadent cheese made by skilled craftspeople. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Droolshroom
items.description: A mushroom that grows in a secret spot known only to Wudwuds. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Delishroom
items.description: An extremely rare delicacy that is cause for a Wudwud celebration. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Mud Shrimp
items.description: A nutritious shrimp native to Oilwell Basin and favored in Azuz. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Turbid Shrimp
items.description: A large, chewy shrimp packed to the gills with nutrients. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Fluffy Egg
items.description: An egg with a yolk and white as fluffy as the Downy Crake that laid it. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Airy Egg
items.description: A high-quality egg that sends you straight to flavor heaven. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Sild Garlic
items.description: A highly nutritious and fragrant bulb of garlic grown in Sild. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Specialty Sild Garlic
items.description: The ultimate bulb of garlic, grown in just the right conditions. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Wild Herb
items.description: This herb's refreshing aroma can mask any foul odor. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Eastern Honey
items.description: Has a unique flavor, making it the perfect secret ingredient. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Monster Chili
items.description: A powerful spice that enhances flavor and sweat production. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Jeweled Mullet Roe
items.description: These fish eggs truly shine like diamonds. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Wild Seed Oil
items.description: Oil that packs both flavor and the power of nature. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Truffle Du Conga
items.description: Often dug up by its namesake, Congalala. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Sinister Cloth
items.description: Suspicious cloth found somewhere in the Windward Plains. Drips with an aura of pure evil.

items.name: Great Hornfly
items.description: Found in the Scarlet Forest. An insect with a giant horn, huge shell, and butterfly wings.

items.name: Windward Aloe
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. The water stored within its plump leaves has saved many a parched traveler.

items.name: Fine Windward Aloe
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A single drop of its delicious sap transforms water into ambrosia.

items.name: Great Windward Aloe
items.description: A treasure of the Windward Plains. Its leaves hold enough water to fill a bath in the driest desert.

items.name: Sandpepper
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. This dried spice lends a rich and aromatic heat to any dish.

items.name: Fiery Sandpepper
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A spice so hot that a single bite opens the taster's third eye.

items.name: Fulgurite Shard
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. The shape of this fulgurite was sculpted by a chance lightning strike.

items.name: Pure Fulgurite
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. Crystallized fulgurite, free of any impurity. Extremely delicate.

items.name: Thundering Fulgurite
items.description: A treasure of the Windward Plains. A colossal fulgurite crystal, born of a sky-splitting thunderstrike.

items.name: Scarlet Amber Shard
items.description: Amber from the Scarlet Forest. The bodies of fossilized insects float in its scarlet confines.

items.name: Fine Scarlet Amber
items.description: Rare amber from the Scarlet Forest. Immaculate insect specimens sleep in this amber, red as fine liquor.

items.name: Eternal Scarlet Amber
items.description: Colossal amber from the Scarlet Forest. Ancient life has been sealed away inside it for eons.

items.name: Queensbloom Pollen
items.description: Pollen from a giant flower in the Scarlet Forest, as regal as it is massive. Makes a heady perfume.

items.name: Shiny Treasure
items.description: An ancient artifact Wudwuds found in the Scarlet Forest. Purely aesthetic in nature.

items.name: Sparkly Treasure
items.description: A rarity of the Scarlet Forest. The fine detail and lavish use of gold show quite advanced techniques.

items.name: Bulky Treasure
items.description: The sheer scale of this Scarlet Forest rarity makes it the object of obsession for all Wudwuds.

items.name: Auric Oil
items.description: Exceptionally pure, golden mineral oil from Oilwell Basin. Used widely in Flameborn crafts.

items.name: Antimite
items.description: A mineral from Oilwell Basin with a unique sheen. Used by the Flameborn in alloy production.

items.name: Fine Antimite
items.description: An Oilwell Basin rarity too pure to be worked by any but the Flameborn artisans.

items.name: Antimite Mass
items.description: A hulking antimite formation that produces strange reactions not yet understood by science.

items.name: Hirabami Molting
items.description: Skin shed from a Hirabami. Treasured by the people of the Iceshard Cliffs as a curative.

items.name: Wyvernscale Vase
items.description: An ancient ornamental vase found in the Iceshard Cliffs. The techniques used to craft it are lost to time.

items.name: Dragonscale Vase
items.description: Each individual scale ornamenting this vase from the Iceshard Cliffs sparkles with a fiery brilliance.

items.name: Large Goldenscale Vase
items.description: An exquisite, inscribed vase from the Iceshard Cliffs. A treasure worthy of kings, lost to the world.

items.name: Wyveria Lantern
items.description: Fruit encased in a mesh shell, found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A precious source of sustenance to the natives.

items.name: Mature Wyveria Lantern
items.description: A rarity in the Ruins of Wyveria. The ripening process imbues the fruit with medicinal properties.

items.name: Origin Wylk Gem
items.description: A precious find from the Ruins of Wyveria. More transparent than other Wylkdrops and has considerable heft.

items.name: Milky Cocoon Web
items.description: A curious fiber found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A resource treasured by the Keepers.

items.name: Wylk Pebble
items.description: Small stones found across the East. A rich source of energy, they are often burned for fuel.

items.name: Wylk Gem
items.description: A beautiful, faintly luminescent stone occasionally found inside Wylkdrops harvested in the East.

items.name: Time-honed Wylk Gem
items.description: The size of this rare find from the East is the result of an eons-long natural formation process.

items.name: Ancient Fossil
items.description: The blackened, stony remains of old bones unearthed in the East. When polished, it gains a velvety sheen.

items.name: Drifting Sea Pot
items.description: A species of translucent sea squirts found in the East. When salt-dried, it becomes a fine preserved food.

items.name: Royal Sea Pot
items.description: A rare, meatier species of sea squirt found in the East. Keeps its rich flavor, even when preserved.

items.name: Gobletweed
items.description: Algae that grows in the East. It resembles a ceremonial cup— Cheers for finding such a beauty!

items.name: Chaliceweed
items.description: Care must be taken not to disturb the delicate form of this rare and stunning algae when harvesting it.

items.name: Nightflower Pollen
items.description: Pollen from a flower that blooms under a full moon. It exudes an ethereal pale glow.

items.name: Fossilized Opal
items.description: A mass of organic material fossilized into opal over time. It has a deep crimson shine.

items.name: Fossilized Fire Opal
items.description: This gorgeous fossil is marked by an exceptionally clear and fiery opal. A truly radiant rarity.

items.name: Genesis Opal
items.description: The opal inclusion in this fossil burns with the fire of creation that first shaped this world.

items.name: Wyvernsprout
items.description: A parasitic fungus that grows on the bodies of dead monsters. Prized as a symbol of reincarnation.

items.name: Whetfish Fin
items.description: A fish fin that greatly restores sharpness and requires fewer strokes than a whetstone.

items.name: Sushifish Scale
items.description: A scale from a Sushifish. Slightly restores health and treats bleeding.

items.name: Lala Barina Shell
items.description: The outer shell of a Lala Barina. Has a dark luster and is wonderfully lightweight.

items.name: Lala Barina Claw
items.description: A claw from a Lala Barina. Vivid scarlet decorates its keen edge.

items.name: Lala Barina Stinger
items.description: The stinger from a Lala Barina. Sharp as a sword, one thrust is all it takes to subdue prey.

items.name: Lala Barina Certificate
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Lala Barina. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Lala Barina Floret
items.description: Hair from a Lala Barina. So white and pristine that it could pass for a high quality pelt.

items.name: Krano Copper
items.description: Copper pyrite from a Kranodath's shell. Its luster makes it a prime material for decorations.

items.name: Krano Pyrite
items.description: High-quality copper pyrite from a Kranodath's shell. Its brilliant sheen is stunning to behold.

items.name: Thunder Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with thunder element.

items.name: Frost Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with ice element.

items.name: Dragon Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with dragon element.

items.name: Fresh Honey
items.description: Special honey gathered from Y'sai's spot. Can be delivered to Provisions, who's running low.

items.name: Frostburst
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with the ice element. Use it to stagger a monster when you're in a pinch.

items.name: Dragonstrike Nut
items.description: A nut that explodes on impact. Used to make Wyvern Ammo.

items.name: Bomberry
items.description: A berry that ruptures on impact. Used to make cluster bombs.

items.name: Chatacabra Certificate
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Chatacabra. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Chatacabra Scale+
items.description: A high-quality Chatacabra scale. Its enhanced durability makes it impervious to most blows.

items.name: Chatacabra Jaw+
items.description: Fine plating from a Chatacabra's hulking jaw. Its density and heft are quite impressive.

items.name: Chatacabra Hide+
items.description: A high-quality Chatacabra hide. Tempered by its harsh environment. Makes a fine crafting material.

items.name: Chatacabra Carapace
items.description: Stout plating from a Chatacabra's arms. Constant friction with the ground has polished it to gleam.

items.description: A sturdy Nerscylla carapace. The porcelain-white material is highly prized, particularly among women.

items.name: Nerscylla Claw+
items.description: This keen Nerscylla claw lashes out from the shadows to claim an ever-growing list of victims.

items.name: Nerscylla Spike+
items.description: An especially large Nerscylla spike, prized more for its lethal poison sac than its sharpness.

items.name: Nerscylla Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Nerscylla. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Kut-Ku Scale+
items.description: Quality scale from a Yian Kut-Ku. Its size and weight make it even more impressive than normal.

items.name: Kut-Ku Carapace
items.description: Unyielding Yian Kut-Ku carapace. Its vivid red hue won't dim even when exposed to intense heat.

items.name: Kut-Ku Ear
items.description: The distinctive ear of a Yian Kut-Ku. Stretchy and resistant to fire, it makes fine armor lining.

items.name: Giant Beak
items.description: The massive beak of a Yian Kut-Ku. Sturdy enough to peck through even the rockiest of terrain.

items.name: Kut-Ku Wing
items.description: Quality Yian Kut-Ku wing membrane. A triple threat of sturdiness, flexibility, and fire resistance.

items.name: Yian Kut-Ku Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Yian Kut-Ku. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Rubbery Hide
items.description: Elastic, electricity-resistant hide worn by a Nerscylla. Thought to be from another monster.

items.name: Rubbery Hide+
items.description: The quality hide of a Gypceros. The baggy, stretchy feel of it is oddly pleasing to the wearer.

items.name: Gypceros Wing
items.description: A quality Gypceros wing membrane. Offers the same shock and poison protection—now with comfy stretch!

items.name: Gypceros Head
items.description: The uniquely shaped head of a Gypceros. A must-have for Gypceros lovers!

items.name: Gypceros Tail
items.description: The tail of a Gypceros. The most pliant body part, and thus the most difficult part to damage.

items.name: Gypceros Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gypceros. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Bird Wyvern Gem
items.description: A valuable gem that can be harvested from bird wyverns. Said to fetch a high price on the market.

items.name: Dash Extract
items.description: A mysterious substance culled from certain monsters that increases endurance.

items.name: Rathian Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Rathian. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Blangonga Pelt+
items.description: Fine fur from a Blangonga. Its springy resilience and warmth make it prized in cold regions.

items.name: Blangonga Fang+
items.description: A Blangonga canine. As large as a human thigh, it's basically a weapon already.

items.name: Blangonga Whisker
items.description: A glorious mustache is the mark and pride of a Blangonga leader, a symbol of its might.

items.name: Blangonga Tail
items.description: The tail of a Blangonga. The silky, lustrous coat is heavenly to the touch.

items.name: Blangonga Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Blangonga. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Gravios Carapace
items.description: The sturdy carapace of a Gravios. Fused with ore by intense heat, it has grown abnormally tough.

items.name: Gravios Skull
items.description: The head armor of a Gravios, hardened by its own heat. Makes it hard to work with, too.

items.name: Gravios Pleura+
items.description: Shell that covers a Gravios's torso. It's grown so thick over time that average attacks do nothing to it.

items.name: Gravios Medulla
items.description: Though hard to extract and hard to craft, the brain stem is an especially precious Gravios part.

items.name: Gravios Wing
items.description: The hefty wing of a Gravios. Recently, the demand and value of the material has been rising.

items.name: Gravios Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gravios. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Rathalos Scale+
items.description: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

items.name: Rathalos Carapace
items.description: This Rathalos carapace emanates a nobility befitting the King of the Skies.

items.name: Rathalos Wing
items.description: The wing of a Rathalos. Skilled artisans can craft it into strong equipment.

items.name: Rathalos Tail
items.description: A severed Rathalos tail covered in plates and keen spines. It has any number of uses.

items.name: Rathalos Ruby
items.description: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathalos. Almost too nice to use.

items.name: Rathalos Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Rathalos. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Gore Magala Scale+
items.description: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.

items.name: Gore Magala Carapace
items.description: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.

items.name: Gore Magala Wing+
items.description: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.

items.name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
items.description: A claw from a Gore Magala's second foreleg. It inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.

items.name: Gore Magala Tail
items.description: A pliant tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.

items.name: Gore Magala Feeler+
items.description: A well-honed sensory organ from a Gore Magala that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.

items.name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
items.description: A pure, jet-black jewel that imprisons and swallows all nearby light.

items.name: Gore Magala Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gore Magala. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Frenzy Crystal
items.description: An unsettling crystal wreathed in Frenzied power. Handle with extreme care.

items.name: Conga Pelt
items.description: A Conga pelt. Sturdy and soft to the touch but must be deodorized before it's processed.

items.name: Conga Pelt+
items.description: A high-quality Conga pelt. The thick fur can be used to make long-lasting equipment.

items.name: Vespoid Shell
items.description: A Vespoid shell. If processed correctly, it can become just as tough as a wyvern's hide.

items.name: Vespoid Carapace
items.description: The hard carapace of a Vespoid. It takes on a unique quality once processed.

items.name: Vespoid Wing
items.description: The wing of a Vespoid. Extremely difficult to process and produces widely varying results.

items.name: Vespoid Innerwing
items.description: The innerwing of a Vespoid. Sharp and elegant, like a blade.

items.name: Blango Pelt+
items.description: A high-quality Blango pelt. Difficult to process, but valuable nonetheless.

items.name: Lightcrystal
items.description: A precious and extremely hard substance with a faint glow. Sometimes used for crafting tools.

items.name: Novacrystal
items.description: High quality Lightcrystal. Highly coveted for its rarity, it's used for only the finest of metalworking.

items.name: Firestone
items.description: Ore that is scorching even at room temperature. Its heat can be used to fuse materials.

items.name: Firecell Stone
items.description: A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can handle. Armor made from it is first-class.

items.name: Fucium Ore
items.description: A mysterious metal found in the Ruins of Wyveria, capable of fusing any other materials together.

items.name: Icium
items.description: Precious metal from the Iceshard Cliffs. Shines bright white when the light catches it.

items.name: Guardian Fulgur Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Congalala Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Congalala. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Charred Oilbone
items.description: A bone found in the Oilwell Basin. Covered in a thick coat of oil that built up over many years.

items.name: Frozen Icebone
items.description: A bone found in the Iceshard Cliffs. Tempered over millennia deep within the frozen earth.

items.name: Tough Guardian Bone
items.description: A bone found in the Ruins of Wyveria. Its peculiar shape is unique to the local wildlife.

items.name: Quality Bone
items.description: A bone used as crafting material. Its ease of use and hardness allow it to be shaped into better gear.

items.name: Crushed Crystal
items.description: A shard of crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Cloudy Crystal
items.description: A hazy crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Coruscating Crystal
items.description: A glittering crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Flame Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with flammable powder. Handle with extreme care.

items.name: Inferno Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with powder that ignites if it so much as touches air. Danger!

items.name: Aqua Sac
items.description: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve water.

items.name: Torrent Sac
items.description: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve copious amounts of water.

items.name: Thunder Sac
items.description: A monster organ that can store up large amounts of high voltage electricity.

items.name: Frost Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with extremely cold fluid. Handle with care.

items.name: Freezer Sac
items.description: A monster organ with tremendous chilling power. Flash-freezes its surroundings.

items.name: Poison Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with a lethal toxin. Handle with extreme care.

items.name: Toxin Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with an extremely potent toxin. Even one touch can be risky.

items.name: Lala Barina Mucus
items.description: Body fluid from a Lala Barina. A sticky, red liquid that causes paralysis.

items.name: Lala Barina Mucus+
items.description: Thick body fluid from a Lala Barina. As red as fresh blood, it contains a powerful paralytic.

items.name: Sleep Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with a knockout powder capable of inducing sleep.

items.name: Coma Sac
items.description: A monster organ filled with a dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.

items.name: Guardian Blood
items.description: Guardian blood containing an unknown substance. A valuable research material.

items.name: Guardian Blood+
items.description: Guardian blood with rather peculiar properties. Requires further research.

items.name: Great Hibiscus
items.description: A large, brightly colored flower found in the Ruins of Wyveria. Spreads its seeds through the air.

items.name: Dalthydon Wool
items.description: A product of Kunafa. Perfectly suited for desert life. Try bringing it to the Smithy.

items.name: Azuz Tanned Leather
items.description: A product of Azuz. The leather is repeatedly repaired for extended use. Try taking it to the Smithy.

items.name: Suja Textiles
items.description: A product of Suja. Its unique pattern has roots in Wyverian tradition. Try taking it to the Smithy.

items.name: Sild Cotton
items.description: A product of Sild. A high-quality material that can be used as-is. Try bringing it to the Smithy.

items.name: Gajau Hide
items.description: The hide of a Gajau. Covered in a thick slime that grants water resistance.

items.name: Speartuna Fin
items.description: The sharp fin of a Speartuna. Might be useful for something if you bring it to the Smithy.

items.name: Commission Ticket
items.description: A ticket in the image of a hunter who traveled to the New World. Try taking it to the Smithy.

items.name: Mimiphyta Ticket
items.description: A ticket depicting the ecology of Mimiphyta. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Mystery Orb - Sword
items.description: A sphere with faint power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

items.name: Glowing Orb - Sword
items.description: A sphere with hidden power that can be revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

items.name: Ancient Orb - Sword
items.description: A sphere with incredible power that can be revealed through appraisal. Becomes an offensive decoration.

items.name: Armor Sphere
items.description: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a tiny amount.

items.name: Armor Sphere+
items.description: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a small amount.

items.name: Advanced Armor Sphere
items.description: Reacts uniquely to heat. Fuse this to armor to improve it.

items.name: Hard Armor Sphere
items.description: A rigid, high-density armor sphere. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a great amount.

items.name: Rocksteady Mantle
items.description: Negates damage reactions, protects hearing, grants wind and tremor resistance, and reduces damage.

items.name: Mending Mantle
items.description: Steadily restores health over a set amount of time.

items.name: Evasion Mantle
items.description: Upon just evading a blow, triggers a special evasive maneuver that boosts attack and alters combos.

items.name: Corrupted Mantle
items.description: Decreases health, but raises affinity and weapon stats. Attack and affinity further increased in certain conditions.

items.name: Wyvern Egg
items.description: A flying wyvern's egg. Deliver it back to camp...if you can.

items.name: Charred Lizard
items.description: A lizard charred crispy by Wudwuds. Removes all traces of poison and restores both health and stamina.

items.name: Wild Jerky
items.description: Dried meat beloved for its wild flavor and toughness. Increases natural healing and cures bleeding.

items.name: Catalyst
items.description: Works with other materials to enhance their effects. Cannot be used by itself.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: A dangerous substance that explodes when struck or heated. Used in Large Barrel Bombs.

items.name: Small Barrel
items.description: A small, empty barrel. Combine with fire herbs to make it into a bomb.

items.name: Large Barrel
items.description: A large, empty barrel. Combine with gunpowder to make it into a bomb.

items.name: Spider Web
items.description: A very sticky web. Used to craft pitfall traps.

items.name: Net
items.description: A sturdy net that supports a certain amount of weight without breaking. Perfect for pitfall traps.

items.name: Gunpowderfish Scale
items.description: A Gunpowderfish scale. Combine with a large barrel bomb to dramatically increase its firepower.

items.name: Burst Arowana Scale
items.description: A Burst Arowana scale. Combine with Normal Ammo to make a large amount of Slicing Ammo.

items.name: Bomb Arowana Scale
items.description: A Bomb Arowana scale. Combine with Normal Ammo to make a large amount of Sticky Ammo.

items.name: Gilded Scale
items.description: A Goldenfry scale. Used by artisans in their crafts.

items.name: Golden Scale
items.description: A Goldenfish scale. They shimmer like only pure gold can.

items.name: Platinum Scale
items.description: A Platinumfish scale. They give off a beautiful gleam.

items.name: Pick-a-meal Voucher
items.description: Exchange this voucher in the Grand Hub Canteen for one order of your favorite regional meal.

items.name: Steel Melding Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a slight discount.

items.name: Silver Melding Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a discount.

items.name: Steel Relic Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a slight discount.

items.name: Silver Relic Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a discount.

items.name: Steel Egg
items.description: An egg of glittering steel. Rare but useless to hunters. Sells for a good price.

items.name: Silver Egg
items.description: An egg of glittering silver. Rare but useless to hunters. Sells for a very good price.

items.name: Golden Egg
items.description: An egg of glittering gold. Valuable but useless to hunters. Sells for a fortune.

items.name: Heavy Armor Sphere
items.description: A solid, high-density armor sphere. Fuse this to armor to improve it by a vast amount.

items.name: Monster Keenbone
items.description: Bone obtained from high-rank large monsters. It has a razor sharp tip that retains its strength after forging.

items.name: Monster Hardbone
items.description: Precious bone obtained from high rank large monsters. Their rarity makes them highly sought after.

items.name: Stoutbone
items.description: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Very sturdy.

items.name: Great Stoutbone
items.description: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Extremely solid and durable.

items.name: Hunter Symbol I
items.description: Proof that you've hunted a tempered monster, certifying your strength.

items.name: Hunter Symbol II
items.description: Proof that you've hunted a fierce tempered monster, certifying your fearlessness.

items.name: Hunter Symbol III
items.description: Proof that you've hunted a vicious tempered monster, certifying your heroism.

items.name: Gold Melding Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding decorations to get a great discount.

items.name: Gold Relic Ticket
items.description: A ticket used by Wyverians. Hand it over when melding relics to get a great discount.

items.name: Guardian Pelt
items.description: Contains an unknown substance. It has lost any color it previously had and courses with energy.

items.name: Guardian Pelt+
items.description: A high-quality Guardian pelt. Exceptionally smooth and tough.

items.name: Drearisite
items.description: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. Has been used to make equipment since ancient times.

items.name: Specklite
items.description: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. Not as pure as it could be, but still of impeccable quality.

items.name: Argecite
items.description: A mysterious material smelted in Azuz. It's apparently primarily used in high-quality equipment.

items.name: Oricalcite
items.description: A mysterious, high-quality material smelted in Azuz. Equipment made from it is second to none.

items.name: Common Wood Minnow
items.description: A common wooden lure shaped like a small fish. Good for any kind of fish.

items.name: Golden Bughead
items.description: A lure that looks like a shining beetle. Good for catching gaudy fish, like Goldenfish.

items.name: Emerald Jitterbait
items.description: A lure with a blade made of ore. Good for catching useful fish, like Sushifish.

items.name: Tuff Joint Bait
items.description: A lure shaped like a Cephalos. Good for catching large, swift fish, like Gastronome Tuna.

items.name: Duster Rig
items.description: A lure shaped like a Starduster. Good for catching fish that like dark or muddy places, like Gajau.

items.name: Tentacle Jig
items.description: A lure made with thorngrass. Good for catching aquatic creatures that have tentacles or feelers.

items.name: Close-range Coating
items.description: A coating designed to deal more damage to nearby targets, at the cost of a reduced maximum range.

items.name: Power Coating
items.description: A coating that increases the attack power of arrows.

items.name: Pierce Coating
items.description: A coating that increases piercing ability. Depending on the monster, it can deal multiple hits.

items.name: Paralysis Coating
items.description: A coating that applies paralysis effects to arrows.

items.name: Poison Coating
items.description: A coating that applies poison effects to arrows.

items.name: Sleep Coating
items.description: A coating that applies sleep effects to arrows.

items.name: Blast Coating
items.description: A coating that applies explosive powder to arrows.

items.name: Exhaust Coating
items.description: A coating that applies a fluid which induces exhaust to arrows.

items.name: Whetfish Fin+
items.description: A fish fin used to sharpen weapons. Works better than a whetstone and can be reused if you're lucky.

items.name: Great Sushifish Scale
items.description: Scale from a Sushifish. Eat to get a large health/natural healing boost or to treat bleeding.

items.name: Old Weapon Shard - Blade
items.description: A piece of a discarded, old blade. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Old Weapon Shard - Tube
items.description: A cylindrical part of an old weapon that's been thrown away. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Old Weapon Shard - Disc
items.description: A disc-like part of an old weapon that's been thrown away. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Old Weapon Shard - Device
items.description: A part of an old weapon that has some sort of device on it. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Gracium
items.description: Precious ore from the Iceshard Cliffs. Swathed in frigid air that shines pale blue when the light catches it.

items.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Shard
items.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
items.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
items.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
items.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Chunk
items.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. One of the largest of its kind. Can be used as a melding material.

items.name: Balahara Black Pearl
items.description: A jewel formed from ore that spent years inside a Balahara. Bewitchingly beautiful.

items.name: Guardian Rathalos Ruby
items.description: A rare jewel that developed in a Guardian Rathalos's body. Said to wield the power of an inferno.

items.name: Guardian Rathalos Plate
items.description: A plate from a Guardian Rathalos. Strengthened by the flow of energy, its inherent heat blazes forth.

items.name: Jin Dahaad Tail
items.description: The tail of a Jin Dahaad. Has a cooling organ that continues to make cold air even when severed.

items.name: Expedition Headgear Ticket
items.description: A ticket inscribed with the emblem of the expedition. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Zoh Shia Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted Zoh Shia. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Zoh Shia Crystalscale
items.description: A crystallized Zoh Shia scale. Its dull glow evinces the great energy it contains.

items.name: Zoh Shia Layershell
items.description: The coiled nature of Zoh Shia's layered shell looks as though it protects as much as it constricts.

items.name: Zoh Shia Stakeclaw
items.description: Stake-like Zoh Shia claws extended by hardened Wylk. The Wylkrystal growths are eerily uniform.

items.name: Zoh Shia Crystalhorn
items.description: A crystal-coated Zoh Shia horn. Heavy and wedge-like, as though it were used to seal something.

items.name: Zoh Shia Crystaltail
items.description: A crystal-covered Zoh Shia tail. The crystals continue to grow even after the tail is severed.

items.name: Faux Whitegleam Orb
items.description: An inorganic orb from inside Zoh Shia. Something wriggles deep within its elaborate design.

items.name: Blackember Mass
items.description: A small, swollen mass from the inside of Zoh Shia. It pulses with an alien-like quality.

items.name: Mizutsune Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Mizutsune. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Mizutsune Scale+
items.description: A high-quality Mizutsune scale. Older scales polished over time can be very valuable.

items.name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
items.description: High-quality purple Mizutsune fur. More foam-absorbent than its lighter counterpart.

items.name: Mizutsune Claw+
items.description: Friction-reducing bubblefoam helps this deadly claw slice through prey like sushi.

items.name: Mizutsune Fin+
items.description: A high-quality Mizutsune fin. Bubblefoam gives it an elegant pattern prettier than dye.

items.name: Mizutsune Tail
items.description: A flowing Mizutsune tail. It's prized for its supple fur and beautiful scales.

items.name: Bubblefoam+
items.description: The top layer of Mizutsune fluid. Removes impurities and is used in many rituals.

items.name: Mizutsune Water Orb
items.description: A multicolored orb formed from a crystallized Mizutsune scale and bubblefoam.

items.name: Rey Dau Certificate γ
items.description: A Guild certificate for hunting an Arch-tempered Rey Dau. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Blossomdance Ticket
items.description: A ticket you receive for attending the Blossomdance. Can be exchanged for festive equipment.

items.name: Blossom Ticket
items.description: A ticket depicting a flowery set of armor. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Blossomdance Catalog
items.description: A ticket depicting elegant decorations. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Chata Coin
items.description: A coin given to those who have bested a Chatacabra in the Arena.

items.name: Rathian Coin
items.description: A coin given to those who have bested a Rathian in the Arena.

items.name: Barrel Bowling Voucher
items.description: A voucher for a chance to play a Grand Hub mini-game. Has a whimsical DIY look.

items.name: Blossomdance Voucher
items.description: A voucher usable only during the Blossomdance. Exchange it for a festive meal.

items.name: Amstrigian Ticket
items.description: A ticket depicting the ecology of Amstrigian. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Sealed Dragon Cloth
items.description: A cloth used to seal the corpse of a dreaded elder dragon. Truth or lie, the ominousness is palatable.

items.name: Blossom Barrel Bomb
items.description: A large barrel bomb from the Blossomdance. Explodes with a flurry of flower petals.

items.name: Pinnacle Coin
items.description: A commemorative coin bestowed on hunters who have mastered the craft. The value of its sheen? Priceless.

items.name: Kunafa Meal Voucher
items.description: Exchange this voucher in the Grand Hub Canteen for one order of the Kunafa regional meal.

items.name: Azuz Meal Voucher
items.description: Exchange this voucher in the Grand Hub Canteen for one order of the Azuz regional meal.

items.name: Sild Meal Voucher
items.description: Exchange this voucher in the Grand Hub Canteen for one order of the Sild regional meal.

items.name: Suja Meal Voucher
items.description: Exchange this voucher in the Grand Hub Canteen for one order of the Suja regional meal.

items.name: Wudwud Treasure
items.description: Treasure given by the Wudwuds. They swear that it's priceless, but it looks like garbage.

items.name: Felyne Ticket
items.description: A ticket depicting sketches of Felynes. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: SF6 Ticket
items.description: A ticket depicting seekers of strength. Give it to the Smithy to get special equipment.

items.name: Assisted Combo: Akuma
items.description: Akuma's Ansatsuken fighting style. Once activated, combine different inputs to unleash fearsome combos.

items.name: Gou Hadoken
items.description: Akuma's signature Hadoken, which can be fired from your slinger. Hold the input to charge.

items.name: Drive Impact
items.description: The fierce Oni Goroshi attack. Use it on wounds or weak points to unleash the Shun Goku Satsu.

items.name: Seregios Slavescale
items.description: A sharp scale the Seregios can make stand on end. Gouges anything it touches.

items.name: Seregios Airblade
items.description: A blade shot from the body and carried on the wind toward unsuspecting hunters.

items.name: Seregios Carver
items.description: Hooked hind leg talons that tear through armor and flesh without mercy.

items.name: Seregios Impaler
items.description: A spear-like tail covered in blade-like scales. Capable of truly horrific things.

items.name: Seregios Breacher
items.description: A sharp horn like a hefty axe that, not surprisingly, makes for fine equipment.

items.name: Seregios Scraper
items.description: A wing talon. Most attacks come from the hind legs; the wings serve to shift weight.

items.name: Seregios Dissenter
items.description: A single scale that points defiantly in a different direction from its brethren.

items.name: Seregios Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Seregios. Used to make equipment.

items.name: Lagiacrus Certificate S
items.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Lagiacrus. Used to make equipment.

monsters.features: A massive Guardian that has been feeding off the Dragontorch's energy. Its body is encased in crystallized Wyvern Milk, allowing it to regenerate. Zoh Shia, like other Guardians, excels at energy attacks and can produce repeated explosions to crystallize the whole area. Beneath its white Guardian coat, its body pulses with dark recollection—which you may see, should it reveal its full power from the days of yore.
monsters.tips: Zoh Shia share the same basic traits of other Guardians. The crystals on their wings and heads can be stripped away to deplete their energy stores. The white crystals on their bodies will grow back weaker, making them easier to destroy a second time. The crystals they create will detonate if they take elemental damage, but a talented hunter can use elemental Slinger ammo and smart maneuvering to make good use of them.

monsters.features: An artificial monster species created by an ancient civilization and imbued with Doshaguma's power. Guardian Doshaguma cannot reproduce and do not require food, relying instead on Wyvern Milk for energy. While anything but agile, they're tough enough to charge right through attacks without flinching, making them extremely dangerous.
monsters.tips: Most Guardian Doshaguma attacks are big forelimb swings. While not agile, the attacks that carry Guardian energy will cause wide explosions. Watch out for the acid in their saliva, which temporarily lowers defense. By dealing with their forearm attacks properly, you can expose a weak point worth exploiting. The crystals formed by their attacks will explode from elemental interference, making Slinger ammo effective.

monsters.features: The flying wyvern that reigns supreme over the Windward Plains' ecosystem. It has adapted to the Sandtide—when it most frequently appears—and is able to store, amplify, and discharge the storm's heavy lightning to lethal effect. Rey Dau is highly territorial and will attack any and all intruders on sight. The fulgurite against its carapace emits a sound that puts every monster in the region on guard.
monsters.tips: When a Rey Dau's wing or tail touches the ground while charged, it causes a reaction that produces a mantle of fulgurite. This widens the appendage's attack range and increases the monster's charging capacity— so make it a point to break these parts. Their heads may also be vulnerable after a discharge attack. Hunters are advised to bring thunder-resistant armor and ice-based weaponry.

monsters.features: Temnocerans native to the Scarlet Forest with distinctive, pirouette-like movements. Their fluids contain a neuroplegic agent which they mix with water to produce red, petal-like bristles on their abdomens. When agitated, Lala Barina open these bristles like a deadly, blossoming flower and release them as florets that paralyze whatever they come into contact with.
monsters.tips: The paralytic effects of a single Lala Barina floret are weak and not enough to subdue a hunter, but repeated contact should be avoided. The stinger on their abdomens makes approaching from the rear a risky bet, but when tired, the stinger will stay exposed and vulnerable. There are reports that when in terrain such as their nests where they hang from above, sustained attacks will knock them down.

monsters.features: Large fanged beasts with pink fur and a distinct crest, which the males sculpt with plant oils and juices as a sign of virility. Congalala are common in temperate forests and are therefore well researched. They're big eaters and love mushrooms, which they absorb and then exhale as a variety of potent breaths that inflict poison, blast, paralysis, and more.
monsters.tips: The stench from a Congalala is so rancid that healing items have no effect. But you can quickly dispel it with a deodorant or by evading in water. Those farts are also trouble, but a hunter might just spot an opportunity if they watch carefully. Congalala are also known to use any breath type—a trick some have attributed to the black mushrooms they're seen digging up.

item.description: The quality hide of a Gypceros. The baggy, stretchy feel of it is oddly pleasing to the wearer.

item.name: Sleep Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with a knockout powder capable of inducing sleep.

item.name: Coma Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with a dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Temnocerans that inhabit the Iceshard Cliffs. They weave vast, sticky webs across their territory, using them and various status ailments to corner prey before utilizing pincer-like jaws to finish it off. Sometimes dead Gypceros can be found in the webs, the hides of which Nerscylla are known to adorn themselves with after devouring the rest of the carcass.
monsters.tips: To defend against the poison, sleep, and binding effects of a Nerscylla's webbing, a hunter must go in duly prepared. While its powerful pincers are quite dangerous, they can and should be targeted as a weakness, provided they are approached correctly. The Gypceros hides draped on a Nerscylla's back are resistant to thunder but susceptible to fire—qualities that are reversed once the hide is destroyed.

monsters.name: Gore Magala
monsters.description: Monsters draped in great wings like a black overcoat. They have no eyes, so instead they use a scattering of fine scales to locate prey.

item.name: Gore Magala Scale+
item.description: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.

item.name: Gore Magala Carapace
item.description: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.

item.name: Gore Magala Wing+
item.description: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.

item.name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
item.description: A claw from a Gore Magala's second foreleg. It inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.

item.name: Gore Magala Tail
item.description: A pliant tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.

item.name: Gore Magala Feeler+
item.description: A well-honed sensory organ from a Gore Magala that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.

item.name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
item.description: A pure, jet-black jewel that imprisons and swallows all nearby light.

item.name: Gore Magala Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gore Magala. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Frenzy Crystal
item.description: An unsettling crystal wreathed in Frenzied power. Handle with extreme care.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Chunk
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. One of the largest of its kind. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Monsters that drape themselves in their great wings, like a black overcoat. They have no eye sensory organs, so instead they use a scattering of fine scales from their wings to locate prey. When their sensory capacity increases, antennae appear on their heads and they unfurl their wings, entering the aggressive Frenzy State. Their black scales can Frenzy other creatures as well, making them fearsome adversaries.
monsters.tips: Gore Magala will use its wings to attack anything it detects with its sensory scales without abandon. If a hunter contracts the Frenzy, their natural healing will decrease and any damage taken will increase, but an experienced hunter knows to keep attacking to raise their metabolism before the virus takes to avoid negative effects. Target the head to put a stop to Gore Magala's Frenzy.

monsters.name: Gravios
monsters.description: Large wyverns found in the Oilwell Basin. Their highly developed carapaces repel attacks and emit powerful heat rays.

item.name: Wyvern Gem
item.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

item.name: Gravios Carapace
item.description: The sturdy carapace of a Gravios. Fused with ore by intense heat, it has grown abnormally tough.

item.name: Gravios Skull
item.description: The head armor of a Gravios, hardened by its own heat. Makes it hard to work with, too.

item.name: Gravios Pleura+
item.description: Shell that covers a Gravios's torso. It's grown so thick over time that average attacks do nothing to it.

item.name: Gravios Medulla
item.description: Though hard to extract and hard to craft, the brain stem is an especially precious Gravios part.

item.name: Gravios Wing
item.description: The hefty wing of a Gravios. Recently, the demand and value of the material has been rising.

item.name: Gravios Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Gravios. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Firecell Stone
item.description: A magma-like deposit that only trained hands can handle. Armor made from it is first-class.

item.name: Inferno Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with powder that ignites if it so much as touches air. Danger!

item.name: Coma Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with a dangerous powder. One whiff can induce a coma.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Large wyverns found in Oilwell Basin. They have a developed physique, powerful heat rays, and a host of gases they can emit from their body. Their bony carapaces are famously tough but expose a surprisingly brittle interior once destroyed.
monsters.tips: It's no easy task breaking through that heavy armor covering a Gravios head to talon, but repeated attacks will eventually make a crack. That—and the weaknesses a Gravios exposes in its carapace during certain attacks—are your chances to deliver Focus Strikes, demolish it piece by piece, and create even more opportunities.

monsters.name: Guardian Arkveld
monsters.description: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization based on a presumed extinct, legendary monster called Arkveld.

item.name: Nourishing Extract
item.description: Can be obtained from some large monsters. Has the ability to amplify the effects of certain medicines.

item.name: Guardian Scale
item.description: Contains an unknown substance. It has lost any color it previously had and possesses unique properties.

item.name: Tough Guardian Bone
item.description: A bone found in the Ruins of Wyveria. Its peculiar shape is unique to the local wildlife.

item.name: Guardian Blood
item.description: Guardian blood containing an unknown substance. A valuable research material.

item.name: Guardian Pelt
item.description: Contains an unknown substance. It has lost any color it previously had and courses with energy.

monsters.features: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization and imbued with the power of a monster called Arkveld. It cannot reproduce and does not require food, relying instead on Wyvern Milk for energy. In addition to absorbing and discharging energy the way other Guardians do, Guardian Arkveld can also absorb elemental energy through the chainblades on its wings and use it for sustenance.
monsters.tips: Guardian Arkveld use retractable chainblades on their wings to attack. Not only are the blades used to absorb and release energy like other Guardians, but they can also convert the energy to the dragon element and discharge it, which will trigger an explosion of the same element if it comes into contact with Wylkrystals. The crystals formed by their attacks will explode from elemental interference, making Slinger ammo effective.

monsters.name: Quematrice
monsters.description: Brute wyverns that spread flammable vapor which they then ignite with their tails. They subsist on prey stolen from other predators.

item.name: Quematrice Scale
item.description: The scale of a Quematrice. Its fine texture acts as a natural file used to grind and polish armor.

item.name: Quematrice Hide
item.description: The hide of a Quematrice. Quite thick despite its wrinkly form, it is highly resistant to fire.

item.name: Quematrice Crest
item.description: The crest of a Quematrice. Its flamboyant red color serves as a decoy to would-be predators.

item.name: Quematrice Tail
item.description: The tail of a Quematrice. Its many pleats scrape against each other to create sparks.

item.name: Wyvern Gem
item.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

item.name: Quematrice Igniter
item.description: Flammable fluids from a Quematrice, expelled as a gas then ignited by sparks from its coarse tail.

item.name: Quematrice Certificate
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Quematrice. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Quematrice Scale+
item.description: A high-quality Quematrice scale. Its keen ridges allow it to cleave stone in a single stroke.

item.name: Quematrice Hide+
item.description: Fine Quematrice hide, hardened by the struggle to survive. Offers exceptional fire protection.

item.name: Quematrice Igniter+
item.description: Especially viscous fluid from a Quematrice. The gas it releases burns at a perilous temperature.

item.name: Quematrice Crest+
item.description: The large crest of a Quematrice. Colored an angry red and shaken violently in a show of aggression.

item.name: Quematrice Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Quematrice. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Shard
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.
