item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Brute wyverns with disproportionately long tails. They spread a flammable substance which vaporizes quickly, then ignite it by dragging their tails along the ground. By nature, Quematrice rarely hunt their own prey, and instead scavenge herbivore carrion left behind by other predators. This often leads to confrontations with other, smaller carnivores.
monsters.tips: Keep an eye on where flammable material settles on the ground to gauge how much a Quematrice's fire will spread. Since they rely on their tails to attack from a distance as well as to start blazes, a hunter can weaken this monster significantly by cutting it off.

monsters.name: Doshaguma
monsters.description: Rugged, territorial fanged beasts that exhibit an aggressive disposition and inhabit a large range. Sometimes observed in large packs.

item.name: Doshaguma Hide
item.description: A Doshaguma hide. The numerous scars on its body are proof of its beastly, aggressive nature.

item.name: Doshaguma Fur
item.description: Doshaguma fur. It makes a durable crafting material thanks to its stiff, bristly texture.

item.name: Doshaguma Claw
item.description: A Doshaguma claw. Sharp as it is tough, it can cut through muscled prey without a single chip.

item.name: Doshaguma Fang
item.description: A Doshaguma fang. They grow large and sharp so they can pierce their prey with ease.

item.name: Beast Gem
item.description: A valuable jewel formed from coagulated juices inside a monster. Glows wildly.

item.name: Sturdy Bone
item.description: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

item.name: Doshaguma Certificate
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Doshaguma. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Doshaguma Fur+
item.description: High-quality Doshaguma fur. So accustomed to harsh climes that it's akin to armor.

item.name: Doshaguma Hide+
item.description: High-quality Doshaguma hide. Its thick, comfortable weight gives reassurance to those who wear it.

item.name: Doshaguma Claw+
item.description: A sharp Doshaguma claw. One poke pierces skin, and one swipe tears flesh from bone.

item.name: Doshaguma Fang+
item.description: A sharp Doshaguma fang. Proof of its owner's feral nature in its ability to chew through even bone.

item.name: Doshaguma Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Doshaguma. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Great Stoutbone
item.description: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Extremely solid and durable.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Fanged beasts that are sometimes seen traveling in packs. Ruggedly built and extremely aggressive, Doshaguma won't hesitate to throw everything they've got at enemies—even other small monsters. They have been known to take prey back to their dens, which sometimes leads to violent disputes.
monsters.tips: When Doshaguma are low on health, their wounds open exposing a weak point. They'll grow more aggressive, though, so beware of counterattacks. Their stomachs are exposed when rising to their hind legs, which is a relatively soft target and potential weak point. Use their mobility to lure them into rock and vine traps. If a Doshaguma pack attacks during a separate hunt, dung pods and large dung pods are a hunter's best friend.

monsters.name: Balahara
monsters.description: Desert-dwelling leviathans that use their supple, serpentine bodies to create quicksand traps. Weak against sonic bombs when they're submerged.

item.name: Sturdy Bone
item.description: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

item.name: Balahara Shell
item.description: A Balahara shell. The fulgurite it has absorbed enhances its hardness.

item.name: Balahara Scale
item.description: A Balahara scale. The erosion caused by constant digging limits its usefulness in crafting.

item.name: Balahara Skull
item.description: The skull of a Balahara. Stronger than most, it's built to withstand harsh dives into sand.

item.name: Balahara Tail
item.description: A Balahara tail. Its unique, twisted shape allows it to propel itself through earth with great force.

item.name: Wyvern Gem
item.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

item.name: Balahara Certificate
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Balahara. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Balahara Scale+
item.description: A high-quality Balahara scale. Thick and durable enough to carve through stone without a scratch.

item.name: Balahara Carapace
item.description: A hard Balahara carapace. A quality material from a specimen wrapped in pure fulgurite.

item.name: Balahara Skull+
item.description: A Balahara's pointy skull. An incredibly tough shell that digs through hard bedrock with ease.

item.name: Balahara Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Balahara. Used to make equipment.

item.description: A monster organ designed to hold and preserve water.

item.name: Balahara Black Pearl
item.description: A jewel formed from ore that spent years inside a Balahara. Bewitchingly beautiful.

monsters.features: Desert-dwelling leviathans that build carapaces out of the fulgurite formed by lightning strikes. They use their flexible skeletons and serpentine bodies to create quicksand traps for unwary prey. Inside their mouths are multiple eye-like sensory organs. The mucus they secrete contains luminous bacteria and is believed to aid visibility while they are submerged and other low-light conditions like sandstorms.
monsters.tips: The interior of a Balahara's mouth is a soft target that can be exploited if you strike right after it expels mucus. Since they rely on heightened hearing while submerged, sonic bombs or screamer pods—obtainable from Baunos—are highly effective. Sometimes the large monster you're hunting will get sucked into a Balahara sand pit...but there's nothing stopping you from going after it.

monsters.name: Rathian
monsters.description: The "Queen of the Land," these female fire-breathing wyverns are known for their powerful legs and lethal, poison-secreting tails.

item.name: Rathian Scale+
item.description: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale but is much harder.

item.name: Rathian Carapace
item.description: Rathian carapace prized for its lavish green coloration. An excellent armor material.

item.name: Rathian Webbing
item.description: A quality Rathian wing membrane. This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

item.name: Rathian Spike+
item.description: Rathian hairs, keen as a sword. Longer and sturdier than normal, they also contain more poison.

item.name: Rathian Ruby
item.description: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathian. Almost too nice to use.

item.name: Rath Medulla
item.description: Only recently extractable due to advances in carving techniques. Hard to forge.

item.name: Rathian Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Rathian. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Inferno Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with powder that ignites if it so much as touches air. Danger!

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Fire-breathing female wyverns known as the "Queens of the Land." Their powerful legs and venomous tails make them efficient ground hunters. At times, Rathian and Rathalos can be sighted hunting as a couple. After laying eggs, Rathian are extremely watchful of their nests. Proceed with extra caution, as a mother will move swiftly to protect her young.
monsters.tips: Hunters will need to maneuver carefully to avoid the potent venom in the Rathian's tail spikes and her wide attack range. By severing the tail, you can limit her reach and gain the upper hand. After breathing fire, the inside of the Rathian's mouth becomes tender, making it a prime target to strike.

monsters.name: Chatacabra
monsters.description: Amphibians that affix rocks to their forelimbs to power up attacks. Break this "armor" to create an attack opening. The tongue is most vulnerable.

item.name: Sturdy Bone
item.description: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

item.name: Chatacabra Jaw
item.description: The mandible plating of a Chatacabra. Hard protrusions stud the thick but supple leather.

item.name: Chatacabra Hide
item.description: The thick hide of a Chatacabra. Elastic and easy to mold thanks to the monster's gluttonous diet.

item.name: Chatacabra Shell
item.description: Plating that covers a Chatacabra's forelimbs. A lifetime of licking has left it both smooth and sturdy.

item.name: Chatacabra Scale
item.description: A jagged scale from a Chatacabra's hide, especially tough and well suited for use in crafting armor.

item.name: Chatacabra Certificate
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Chatacabra. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Chatacabra Scale+
item.description: A high-quality Chatacabra scale. Its enhanced durability makes it impervious to most blows.

item.name: Chatacabra Jaw+
item.description: Fine plating from a Chatacabra's hulking jaw. Its density and heft are quite impressive.

item.name: Chatacabra Hide+
item.description: A high-quality Chatacabra hide. Tempered by its harsh environment. Makes a fine crafting material.

item.name: Chatacabra Carapace
item.description: Stout plating from a Chatacabra's arms. Constant friction with the ground has polished it to gleam.

item.name: Chatacabra Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Chatacabra. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Stoutbone
item.description: The bone of a large, high ranking monster. Very sturdy.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Shard
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: Amphibians that use their long tongues to seize and devour prey such as Bulaqchi. Their evolved forelimbs store a sticky mucus-like substance. When agitated, Chatacabra rub their forelimbs against the ground to collect stone and ore, widening the range and destructiveness of their blows.
monsters.tips: The Chatacabra's soft tongue is the place to strike; look for openings after their attacks or when they become tired. Destroying the ore stuck to their forelimbs will leave them wide open to attack. They roam a wide area, so environmental elements like falling boulders or Flashflies will be useful in taking them down. To give you an idea of how hungry these things can get, some hunters have witnessed them swallowing entire barrels during their charges.

monsters.name: Mizutsune
monsters.description: Specially evolved leviathans, Mizutsune can secrete a peculiar foam that deftly covers their foes in dangerous bubbles.

item.name: Monster Keenbone
item.description: Bone obtained from high-rank large monsters. It has a razor sharp tip that retains its strength after forging.

item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone Chunk
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. One of the largest of its kind. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Mizutsune Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Mizutsune. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Mizutsune Scale+
item.description: A high-quality Mizutsune scale. Older scales polished over time can be very valuable.

item.name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
item.description: High-quality purple Mizutsune fur. More foam-absorbent than its lighter counterpart.

item.name: Mizutsune Claw+
item.description: Friction-reducing bubblefoam helps this deadly claw slice through prey like sushi.

item.name: Mizutsune Fin+
item.description: A high-quality Mizutsune fin. Bubblefoam gives it an elegant pattern prettier than dye.

item.name: Mizutsune Tail
item.description: A flowing Mizutsune tail. It's prized for its supple fur and beautiful scales.

item.name: Bubblefoam+
item.description: The top layer of Mizutsune fluid. Removes impurities and is used in many rituals.

item.name: Mizutsune Water Orb
item.description: A multicolored orb formed from a crystallized Mizutsune scale and bubblefoam.

monsters.features: Specially evolved leviathans with sleek, lithe bodies, Mizutsune can secrete a peculiar foam that covers their foes in immobilizing bubbles. Once their prey's movement is impaired, they'll close in with spry, dance-like movements.
monsters.tips: The foam of a Mizutsune allows it to move with incredible agility even on land, but that's not all. Different kinds of foam produce unique effects, such as inflicting bubbleblight, healing hunters, or boosting your attacks. They can even employ an explosive foam when angered. If you are inflicted with bubbleblight, you'll be left open for longer after taking an attack, so fix yourself up quickly with a cleanser.

monsters.name: Guardian Fulgur Anjanath
monsters.description: An artificial species created by an ancient civilization with a Fulgur Anjanath's power. They can discharge lightning and have a nasty bite.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Scale+
item.description: A high-quality Guardian Fulgur Anjanath scale. Surprisingly heavy, and zaps you when touched.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Pelt+
item.description: A high-quality Guardian Fulgur Anjanath pelt. Wild patterns have overshadowed its original form.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Fang+
item.description: A sharp fang from a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath. Built to withstand the fierce crushing power of its jaw.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Nosebone+
item.description: The nasal bone of a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath. The mucus from it is charged with electricity.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Tail
item.description: A Guardian Fulgur Anjanath tail. Packed with thick muscles that help it maintain balance.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Gem
item.description: A rare jewel that developed within a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath. Said to hold the might of the heavens.

item.name: Guardian Fulgur Certificate S

item.name: Coruscating Crystal
item.description: A glittering crystal carved from the carcass of a Guardian. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Guardian Blood+
item.description: Guardian blood with rather peculiar properties. Requires further research.

item.name: Guardian Pelt+
item.description: A high-quality Guardian pelt. Exceptionally smooth and tough.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (S)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Has a deep sanguine hue. Can be used as a melding material.

item.name: Wyverian Bloodstone (L)
item.description: Obtained from destroying a tempered wound. Larger than most of its type. Can be used as a melding material.

monsters.features: An artificial monster species created by an ancient civilization and imbued with Fulgur Anjanath's power. Guardian Fulgur Anjanath cannot reproduce and do not require food, relying instead on Wyvern Milk for energy. Not only can the lightning charged in their bodies be released as an attack, they can also use it to empower themselves and perform vicious biting attacks.
monsters.tips: A hunter must watch out for a Guardian Fulgur Anjanath's sparks and teeth. While their lightning attacks alone are a threat, their maws infused with Guardian energy will cause wide-range explosions. Try to topple one by aggressively targeting its legs. The crystals that form from their attacks will explode through elemental interference, so Slinger ammo can also be effective.

monsters.name: Hirabami
monsters.description: Leviathans that inhabit the Iceshard Cliffs. They have sharp, pincer-like tails and membranes on their necks that catch the wind to keep them aloft.

item.name: Wyvern Gem
item.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

item.name: Hirabami Scale
item.description: A scale from a Hirabami. Though small and lightweight, it's very strong and easy to process.

item.name: Hirabami Hide
item.description: The hide of a Hirabami. Light and smooth like cloth, it is known for its unique texture.

item.name: Hirabami Webbing
item.description: Webbing from a Hirabami. Its superb elasticity allows the monster to float in the air.

item.name: Hirabami Tail Claw
item.description: A claw from the tail of a Hirabami. Its curved shape allows it to easily trap prey.

item.name: Hirabami Certificate
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Hirabami. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Hirabami Scale+
item.description: A high-quality scale from a Hirabami. Not only is it strong, but also exceedingly light.

item.name: Hirabami Hide+
item.description: A high-quality Hirabami hide. Soft as the finest fabric, with the warmth to endure a blizzard.

item.name: Hirabami Webbing+
item.description: High-quality Hirabami webbing. Can manipulate air currents even in the fiercest blizzards.

item.name: Hirabami Tail Claw+
item.description: A high-quality claw from the tail of a Hirabami. No prey can escape its scythe-like bite.

item.name: Hirabami Certificate S
item.description: A Guild certificate awarded to those who have hunted a Hirabami. Used to make equipment.

item.name: Frost Sac
item.description: A monster organ filled with extremely cold fluid. Handle with care.

item.name: Freezer Sac

monsters.features: Leviathans that inhabit the Iceshard Cliffs. They have sharp, pincer-like tails and peculiar membranes on their necks that catch the wind and keep them aloft. Hirabami can sometimes be sighted nesting in groups along the cliffs, using their scales or foreclaws to cling to walls or ceilings while they sleep.
monsters.tips: Hirabami can remain aloft as they maneuver skillfully between the ground and the sky. You'll need to watch out for those tail claws, but handle an attack well to turn it into a counterstrike opportunity. Destroying the membrane on their necks will lower their guards while aloft. Furthermore, you can target the membrane wound to knock them out of the air, making this a prime target.

monsters.features: Bird wyverns with impressive beaks and large ears. They tend to be skittish but will sometimes initiate attacks on a perceived threat. Yian Kut-Ku arrive in large groups during the season of Plenty in the Scarlet Forest. The absence of eggs or young suggests that the purpose of this is not to breed, but rather to seek out mates and nourishment.
monsters.tips: The Yian Kut-Ku's superior hearing comes with great sensitivity to sound. A loud noise is sometimes all it takes to stop them in their tracks, reason enough to make liberal use of sonic bombs. But there's a catch: once a Yian Kut-Ku comes back to itself, it's going to be really flocking mad and come at a hunter even more viciously than before.

monsters.features: Dappled brute wyverns that prowl Oilwell Basin. They use their tails to inject gas into the ground and detonate it, then feed on the small creatures that are unearthed. The toxic gas they spray from their tongues serve to weaken prey, which they then finish off with the blasts. Rompopolo are extremely territorial and will readily engage their own kind.
monsters.tips: Hunters must be wary of the Rompopolo's poisonous explosions. Gas sacs can be found all over their bodies; the anterior ones contain poison, while the posterior sacs are for explosions. If you see one start to swell, strike it to shrink it back down. When fighting in oilsilt, the blasts will kick up rubble that can act as stable footholds.

monsters.features: A flying wyvern that was considered extinct according to documents left behind by the Guild. Their wings have a unique, chain-like blade that can extend and retract freely to reap their prey. They feed on elemental energy absorbed through these chainblades, and are able to convert the energy to unleash dragon element attacks.
monsters.tips: The more energy this monster absorbs, the more ferocious its attacks become. Once they fill their energy tanks, their chainblades will sweep out to attack an even wider area. Conversely, since their wings possess organs that absorb energy, a hunter can force the energy to leak out by focusing attacks there. Flooding them with continuous elemental attacks will eventually overload the organs, forcing the monster out of its enhanced state.

monsters.features: Characteristic by their highly developed carapaces, Ajarakan wrap themselves in molten metal that they rub together to heat up and create explosions. Presumably due to the friction of the metal, they can reach high enough temperatures to melt even the ground or bullets. They can also use their strong limbs to grip onto the ceiling and move around freely, so a hunter must watch out from every angle, including above.
monsters.tips: Approaching an Ajarakan's extreme heat will sap your health, so use cool drinks or Chillmantle Bugs to counteract it. Normal Ammo and arrows will melt if you try to pierce their molten carapaces, so you must use heat-resistant equipment or hit them with Watermoss to bring down their temperature first. Continuous friction will cause their body temperature to rise, but soften their outer shells.

monsters.features: Wyverns that can stun enemies by striking their prominent crests to produce powerful flashes of light. Their stretchy, rubbery hide resists blunt impacts and reduces the effectiveness of shock traps. A smart hunter knows to maneuver carefully around the poisonous filth they spew, which drips from ceilings or down slopes.
monsters.tips: Faced with a Gypceros, a hunter has two headaches to deal with: the poison and the flashes. The poison will pool and hamper your movements, but you can clear it away with some watermoss. As for the flashes, destroying its crest will stop them; in the meantime, it's a good idea to take cover. If you can see its crest glow before the attack, that means you're still inside the dazzling danger radius.

The mucus secreted from their tentacles hardens quickly into sharp edges that resemble blades or spears, which is why some call Xu Wu the "Piercing Assassin." The sizable mouth hidden on their underside allows them to devour even rather large prey.
monsters.tips: Due to their predatory nature, you can expect Xu Wu to attack Guardians inside their habitat. They have no eyes, but their other senses are developed and they excel at catching prey off guard, especially with their ability to enter small crevices and crawl quickly across the ground. When one exposes its mouth, that means a deadly attack is coming, but with a powerful blow, you might be able to topple the creature.

monsters.features: An artificial monster species created by an ancient civilization and imbued with Rathalos's power. Guardian Rathalos cannot reproduce and do not require food, relying instead on Wyvern Milk for energy. Just like the original Rathalos, they are superior fliers and will attack more violently with their claws while airborne.
monsters.tips: The unique Guardian energy from Guardian Rathalos's claw attacks is explosive and dangerous. This energy will cause wyvern milk on the ground to crystalize, and if these crystals are hit by the monster's fire attacks it will cause an explosion of the same element. Given that they are triggered by elemental interference, Slinger ammo could be used effectively against them.

monsters.features: The leviathan that reigns supreme over the Scarlet Forest's ecosystem. It has adapted to water-rich environments and is sighted most often during the Downpour. Uth Duna's secretions when combined with water form a protective veil that not only absorbs hostile blows but also adds weight, which it slams down with enough force to sweep away surrounding threats in the resulting wave.
monsters.tips: Seeing as an Uth Duna's veil reduces attack damage, the first order of business is to dispel it quickly. It will fall away once it loses enough water, but that's not entirely good news; without the veil weighing the monster down, an Uth Duna will become more agile and aggressive. You can dodge their wave with some creative evading, or by using things like Wedge Beetles to escape upward.

The largest ridges on their back are particularly powerful and should be destroyed, but the hide there is very tough unless the other ridges are dealt with first.

monsters.features: The cephalopod that reigns supreme over Oilwell Basin's ecosystem. Usually, when sighted, Nu Udra is covered in oilsilt, but when enraged it will ignite the coating, transfiguring itself into a horror of flame. The oculi that appear on its body and many arms are presumed to be sensory organs, but the truth is still being investigated.
monsters.tips: Each of a Nu Udra's many unique tentacles can be severed. But watch out when they get angry and burst into flame. You can douse any parts that are burning with watermoss— a recommended strategy, since it will leave the monster weakened. A Nu Udra's soft body allows them to slip through crevasses and move in surprising ways, so be careful not to let them get the jump on you.

monsters.features: An artificial monster species created by an ancient civilization and imbued with Ebony Odogaron's power. Guardian Ebony Odogaron cannot reproduce and do not require food, relying instead on Wyvern Milk for energy. They will attempt to corner targets with flurries of attacks from their well-developed claws and tails.
monsters.tips: Guardian Ebony Odogaron are most notable for their honed claws that induce bleeding and dexterous tails, both of which carry Guardian energy that can trigger explosions. If their dragon-element attacks connect with Wylkrystals, it will cause an explosion of the same element. However, since the crystals are triggered through elemental interference Slinger ammo can also be used effectively.

monsters.features: Fearsome male wyverns known as the "Kings of the Skies." Alongside the Rathian, they stake out a wide territory around their nests, and it is the male's role to watch from above. Armed with powerful poisonous claws and fiery breath, Rathalos use their aerial prowess to descend on invaders.
monsters.tips: As Kings of the Skies, Rathalos will attack with a variety of aerial strikes. A bright flash should be enough to disorient them and bring them down. When Rathalos are in trouble, their Rathian mates may swoop in to help, so be sure to have dung pods and large dung pods at the ready.

item.name: Blangonga Fang+

monsters.features: Large, white fanged beasts that rule over other Blango, attacking intruders as a pack. Its muscularity and mobility allows it to strike swiftly, even on fresh snow, and pounce from long distances—so hunters with long-range weapons still need to stay on guard. Large tusks are the mark of a powerful leader.
monsters.tips: Blangonga use snowy ground to their advantage for extra mobility, and can summon other Blangos to gang up on unwary hunters. Use extra caution when they're angry, because they can direct the whole pack at a chosen target with perilous efficiency. Watch out for that freezing breath, too. Destroying a Blangonga's tusks is believed to undermine its authority with the other Blangos, disrupting their teamwork.

monsters.name: Lagiacrus

monsters.features: Leviathans that exist atop the vast aquatic food chain. Lagiacrus generate electricity via their hides to store in their spinal organs, and are capable of discharging a current strong enough to boil the seawater around them. They have been sighted fighting other monsters in the Scarlet Forest, presumably drawn in from other regions in search of prey and more fertile environs.
monsters.tips: The glow of a Lagiacrus's shockspikes are proportional to the amount of electricity they gradually store while attacking. Notably, a brightly glowing shockspike when they are submerged is a good indicator that an intense electrical attack is soon to follow. Attacking and destroying the shockspike has proven to be an effective countermeasure for reducing Lagiacrus's ability to build electric charge, and should be prioritized.

monsters.features: Fiercely territorial flying wyverns known for the sharp, blade-like scales covering their bodies. Boasting swift aerial mobility and lightning-fast footwork, Seregios use their powerful hind legs to make quick work of their prey. Reports confirm that Seregios also have the ability to launch the scales from their bodies, causing lacerations that bleed profusely.
monsters.tips: Beware of flanking attacks and their fierce hind leg strikes. Viciously aggressive, they'll launch their blade-like scales, which can inflict bleeding, and then immediately follow up with additional attacks. Breaking their heads and tail can reduce the number of scales they're able to deploy, so focus on breaking parts while healing your bleeding status as necessary with well-done steaks or by resting briefly.

monsters.name: Omega Planetes
monsters.description: An Omega frame that crossed the interdimensional rift. It descended on the Forbidden Lands to find stronger lifeforms and planets to invade.

item.name: Omega Data 1.0

item.name: Omega Lens

item.name: Omega Axle

item.name: Omega Nodule

monsters.features: An Omega frame that has crossed the inter-dimensional rift and descended on the Forbidden Lands in its search for more powerful lifeforms and planets to invade. Named Omega Planetes to distinguish it from other Omega frames, it plans to study this world's lifeforms, primarily the monsters of the Forbidden Lands, in order to evolve and subjugate everything in its path.
monsters.tips: Becomes incredibly dangerous and aggressive when activating Pantokrator mode. Repeatedly attacking its head will get it to focus on a single hunter who can direct its attacks. If the targeted hunter is in danger, another hunter can draw its  attention by attacking the head again. You can also attack its legs to create opportunities for further attacks, so work together with other hunters to bring it down.

monsters.features: A mysterious elder dragon covered head to tail in a viscous black liquid that was found hibernating in an underground expanse beneath Azuz. It has reportedly been raiding weapon stockpiles across the land to slake its need for gunpowder, and during these confrontations various items have adhered to its body. Among these, most remarkably, is a formidable ancient weapon the likes of which has not been seen in ages.
monsters.tips: The oil covering Gogmazios's body can be softened with fire attacks, making it easier to land hits and exposing its weakness to the dragon element. Knowing what element to use when is key. Weapon fragments may be visible on some of its body parts—break them to obtain materials. Attacking Gogmazios while it is in flight will break its posture and create openings. Beware the super explosion triggered by its gaseous state fire breath.
